about: Store -> Apps LordOS: LordOS's own installable apps and components (apps/store/lordosmodel.js, docs/PACKAGES.md). A new one is an entry here plus its two texts, store.native.<id>.name and store.native.<id>.summary, in every language. kind: deb (a package of LordOS's signed repository, installed by the package engine after its plan), catalog (an apt/catalog.json item with its own page, such as Disk Formats with its licenses) or settings (installed from a Settings page; the Store links to it). installed: package (the default: the package is installed) or voices (a voice model is there, sdk/voicemanager.js). open: what Open does once it is installed: an app ({app, args}) or a Store page ({page}). category: shown in the section's second column once the list has six entries or more (store.native.cat.<category>).
